evidence.claim: At least 15 people were confirmed dead and 7 missing in Kerala as of 4 August 2026 after near-cloudburst rainfall, with damage concentrated in Pathanamthitta, Idukki and Kottayam districts.

The Kerala death toll rose to 26; 27,048 people were housed in 462 relief camps with no camp exceeding 150 residents; families of the dead received Rs 8 lakh, assistance for destroyed houses was raised to Rs 12 lakh and crop compensation was increased 25 per cent.

India was assessed at 16.9 on 2026-08-01 against a published 15.6, on the 20 July 2026 Sansad Chalo protest already assessed on 2026-07-27; a claimed new National Security Act invocation was screened out because the order predated the protest.
